spans.s:
अर्ण अर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. ऋ), being in
motion, agitated; foaming, effervescing; restless;
(अस्), m. a wave, flood, stream; the teak tree, Tec-
tona Grandis L.; a letter; N. of a metre, comprising
ten feet, and belonging to the class called Daṇḍaka;
N. of a man; (अम्), n. tumult or din of battle.
—अर्ण-साति, इस्, f., Ved. tumult of battle.

अर्णव, अस्, आ, अम्, being agitated; foaming;
restless; (अस्), m. a wave, flood, stream; the foaming
sea, high water; the ocean of air; N. of a metre;
title of a work on jurisprudence.
—अर्णव-ज, अस्,
आ, अम्, sea-born, marine; (अस्, अम्), m. n. cuttle fish.
—अर्णव-पोत, अस्, m. a boat or ship.
—अर्णव-
मन्दिर, अस्, m. an epithet of Varuṇa, regent of
the waters.
—अर्णव-यान, अम्, n. a boat or ship.
—अर्णवान्त (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, m. the extremity of
the ocean.
—अर्णवोधव (˚व-उद्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a plant.

अर्णस्, अस्, n. a wave, flood, stream; the sea, ocean;
the ocean of air; river, water.
—अर्णस्-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, Ved. containing many waves.
—अर्णो-द, अस्, m.
a cloud; N. of the plant Cyperus Rotundus.
—अर्णो-
भव, अस्, m. a shell.
—अर्णो-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. in-
cluding the waters.

अर्णस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. watery, full of water, (Sāy.
= उदक-वत्); floating, billowy (according to B. R.).
